key_invariant: Recover missed critical milestones, not skipped weeks.

phases.name: calendar_gap_analysis
phases.description: Compute baseline_progress_index from surviving server and list missing milestones from each source server.

phases.name: catch_up_pool_build
phases.description: Aggregate must_catch_up entries into a single Catch-Up Pool. Bundle optional_catch_up into compressed banners. Compress compress-class into Merge Shop. Skip skip-class entirely.

phases.name: recovery_window_execution
phases.description: Run banner pool with max_parallel_banners. Open Merge Shop with compressed_rewards. Run Merge Carnival socials.

phases.name: route_to_mature_calendar
phases.description: After window end, switch lifecycle_stage to merged_mature and apply Merged Mature Calendar.

banner_pool_rules.pity_policy: inherit_per_account_pity_from_surviving_server; merged accounts retain best pity progress observed
banner_pool_rules.purchase_limit_policy: shared_across_pool; daily caps; weekly caps; account-wide spend ledger view
banner_pool_rules.cosmetic_distribution_fairness: compress cosmetic-only events if non-exclusive; preserve exclusive cosmetics in optional_catch_up
